title: Push a cart
cameraMount: Illustrative chest placement; no calibrated camera extrinsics supplied.

hands.source: DynHaMR 21-joint palm-local fitting to native SMPL-X hands
hands.invalidDisplay: SLERP between smoothed valid finger poses; nearest valid pose held at endpoints; neutral only if no valid pose exists

fit.handTargetFrame: Palm-local, episode-constant scale; wrist orientation from PICO
fit.method: Regularized body-shape least squares and nonlinear hand joint-position fitting

displayRefinement.handSmoothing: Sign-continuous normalized quaternion Gaussian, sigma=1.2 at 15Hz, zero phase, within valid runs only
displayRefinement.armCorrection: Shoulder/elbow IK; preserve wrist world orientation and filtered finger rotations
displayRefinement.collisionSurface: Hand vertices against torso/head/leg surface; arm attachment regions excluded
displayRefinement.scope: Display correction only; source data and SONIC rollout unchanged
